name: Helsinki
limitations: All 31 subpillars are reviewed, not all are measured. Scores require the stated assumptions; unknown evidence remains unknown. This is neither a global ranking nor an exclusion bound. Rejecting a necessary assumption requires reassessment, not automatic retention of its score.

dimensions.rationale: Implemented coastal protection and cooling in priority care facilities support protection; heat, rainfall and slippery winter conditions remain material hazards.
dimensions.assumption: Implemented protection usually works; unreviewed locations and groups do not already face broader unmitigated failure.

dimensions.rationale: Dated local gang-member criminal-report decline linked by police to actual investigations and sentences, bounded resident-survey coverage and a serious Espoo shooting disposition support a limited real-impact/response review. City-adapted regional/critical-service scenarios connect with HSY shared water security: technical monitoring, completed VESKY development, tested joint water exercises and an operating preparedness coordination group. This supports conditional60, not measured whole-FUA low violence or proven attack prevention. Rising street violence/drug observations, survey nonresponse and formal HSY findings of non-uniform communications/situation picture and no joint broad-crisis view remain material counterevidence.
dimensions.assumption: Accept municipal/shared-service applicability, the dated2024–2025 observations and implemented capabilities as continuing to2026-10-10, and limited relevant violence/strategic remaining effects as ordinarily not a dominant inadequately mitigated constraint for median-income Finnish citizens. Survey victim levels are not organised-violence rates; police gang-member report decline is not all-victim incidence and may omit unreported harms. HSY services reasonably reach the ordinary687 resident without equating its entire service area to the FUA; unpublished-date reports/undated scenario text require pre-cutoff availability and version-continuity assumptions. Judge the documented crisis-management and vulnerable-group gaps material but not already broadly disabling after scoped mitigation. Important persistent coercion/targeted harm or crisis-management bottlenecks support40; reject impact coverage, geographic reach, temporal/version continuity or residual-effect inference to restore null with no alternatives. Stronger city/regional low-impact and usable protective-response evidence would be needed for80. No completed war/successful strategic attack, perfect population rate or every-node test prerequisite.

dimensions.rationale: Published delivery results, implemented service changes and preparedness exercises support execution; group reach and actual crisis recovery remain incompletely measured.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution persists and supports usual operation of major services; the reviewed domains are not a complete city-wide performance measurement.

dimensions.rationale: Water monitoring, actual energy delivery and port logistics support usual supply; common electricity dependencies, current backup capacity and household burdens remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Essential resources are usually available and affordable for median-income residents; regional operator evidence does not measure the whole FUA.

dimensions.rationale: Free primary appointments, specified public fees and actual specialist treatment support care pathways; dental delays, voucher conditions and specialist and communication barriers remain constraints.
dimensions.assumption: Necessary care is usually obtainable and clinically adequate; waits and alternative-pathway charges have not become broad unmitigated barriers. Routine clinical outcomes remain unmeasured.

dimensions.rationale: FINGER includes local centres and a two-year randomised human cognitive result; related public services provide a limited translation pathway, without proving current delivery of the full intervention or general resident benefit.
dimensions.assumption: The verified human result and related local services support limited translation readiness. This connection must be challenged; rejecting it leaves LON unresolved rather than automatically assigning 40.

dimensions.rationale: Sustained output from two universities, actual technology transfers and long-term industry absorption connect with broad capital-region use of commerce, authentication and public services, plus delivered local services and assistance. Corporate financing/employment pressures and national older-age usage gaps remain counterevidence, not whole-FUA failure measurements.
dimensions.assumption: The reviewed multi-producer activity, PKS adoption and Helsinki municipal delivery reasonably apply to FUA 687 and ordinary eligible median-income citizens, and persist to the cutoff. Actual service response and assistance materially mitigate the reviewed diffusion barriers; their whole-group reach is not measured. If financing or group-access constraints remain material after mitigation, reassess 60. Rejecting necessary spatial, continuity or resident-usability assumptions restores unknown TEC.

dimensions.rationale: Delivered aviation and international ferries, conditional EU residence and work rights and overseas payment of accrued earnings-related pensions support usable channels; common failures and communications remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Median-income residents usually have usable travel and relocation funds, accounts and communications; legal eligibility does not guarantee jobs, housing or independent transport substitutes.
